memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Osteoarthritis of both knees.
Evidence: bilateral knee pain worsening on weight bearing, morning stiffness <30 minutes, crepitus on examination. Symptoms and examination: patient reports aching pain in both knees, worse after household chores; examination shows mild effusion, limited flexion to 120°, no warmth or redness. Spirometry: FEV1 2.8 L (92% predicted), FVC 3.2 L, FEV1/FVC 0.88; change since prior test N/A. No inhaler prescribed. Smoking status: never smoked, pack-years 0. Plan: start symptomatic therapy, check vitamin D, review in 3 months.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Paracetamol 650 mg – take as needed for pain, max 4 doses per day.
Topical diclofenac gel – apply thin layer to affected knees twice daily.
Calcium with vitamin D3 – one tablet daily.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Serum 25‑OH Vitamin D: 18 ng/mL (Reference range 30‑100 ng/mL).

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Weight‑bearing X‑ray of both knees: mild joint space narrowing, marginal osteophytes, no significant subchondral sclerosis – consistent with grade II osteoarthritis.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Osteoarthritis of both knees.
Evidence: persistent knee pain despite paracetamol SOS, difficulty climbing stairs. Symptoms and examination: patient reports increased pain in right knee after walking 200 m; examination shows tenderness over medial joint line, mild effusion, crepitus, flexion 110°. Spirometry: FEV1 2.75 L (90% predicted), FVC 3.15 L, FEV1/FVC 0.87; ΔFEV1 –0.05 L since last visit. No inhaler prescribed. Smoking status: never smoked, pack-years 0. Plan: reinforce topical NSAID, ensure calcium‑vit D adherence, consider adding glucosamine.

memories.text:
Paracetamol 650 mg – take as needed for pain, max 4 doses per day.
Topical diclofenac gel – apply thin layer to affected knees twice daily.
Calcium with vitamin D3 – one tablet daily.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Serum 25‑OH Vitamin D: 22 ng/mL (Reference range 30‑100 ng/mL).

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Osteoarthritis of both knees.
Evidence: ongoing discomfort, limited response to topical NSAID. Symptoms and examination: patient describes aching pain in both knees after standing >15 min, occasional swelling; examination shows mild synovial thickening, no erythema, flexion 115° bilaterally. Spirometry: FEV1 2.78 L (91% predicted), FVC 3.18 L, FEV1/FVC 0.87; ΔFEV1 +0.03 L since last visit. No inhaler prescribed. Smoking status: never smoked, pack-years 0. Plan: add supervised physiotherapy, continue calcium‑vit D, re‑check vitamin D.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Paracetamol 650 mg – take as needed for pain, max 4 doses per day.
Topical diclofenac gel – apply thin layer to affected knees twice daily.
Calcium with vitamin D3 – one tablet daily.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: "I’ve been feeling more stiffness in my knees when I get up from a chair, and the gel sometimes irritates my skin. Could we try something else for the pain?" - message via clinic app.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Osteoarthritis of both knees.
Evidence: mild improvement with physiotherapy, skin irritation from gel noted. Symptoms and examination: patient reports less pain after physiotherapy sessions, occasional right‑knee ache after long walks; examination shows mild tenderness, no effusion, flexion 120°. Spirometry: FEV1 2.80 L (92% predicted), FVC 3.20 L, FEV1/FVC 0.88; ΔFEV1 +0.02 L since last visit. No inhaler prescribed. Smoking status: never smoked, pack-years 0. Plan: discontinue topical diclofenac due to irritation, continue paracetamol SOS, maintain calcium‑vit D, repeat vitamin D in 3 months.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Paracetamol 650 mg – take as needed for pain, max 4 doses per day.
Calcium with vitamin D3 – one tablet daily.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Serum 25‑OH Vitamin D: 25 ng/mL (Reference range 30‑100 ng/mL). CBC: WBC 6.2×10⁹/L, Hb 12.8 g/dL, Plt 210×10⁹/L – all within normal limits.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Osteoarthritis of both knees.
Evidence: stable symptoms, vitamin D still suboptimal. Symptoms and examination: patient reports mild knee discomfort after household chores, no night pain; examination shows no effusion, mild crepitus, flexion 122°. Spirometry: FEV1 2.82 L (93% predicted), FVC 3.22 L, FEV1/FVC 0.88; ΔFEV1 +0.02 L since last visit. No inhaler prescribed. Smoking status: never smoked, pack-years 0. Plan: initiate vitamin D supplementation, continue paracetamol SOS, review in 3 months.

Vitamin D3 cholecalciferol 1000 IU – one tablet daily.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Osteoarthritis of both knees.
Evidence: vitamin D now adequate, pain controlled. Symptoms and examination: patient denies significant knee pain, occasional mild ache after prolonged standing; examination shows no swelling, flexion 125°, mild crepitus. Spirometry: FEV1 2.85 L (94% predicted), FVC 3.25 L, FEV1/FVC 0.88; ΔFEV1 +0.03 L since last visit. No inhaler prescribed. Smoking status: never smoked, pack-years 0. Plan: maintain current regimen, advise joint protection, next review in 6 months.
